walkthrough.title: Before the first play
walkthrough.lead: Long enough to put the engine in place, and to give you real tags instead of guessed ones.
walkthrough.libraryHint: Your music will be filed in {{path}}

python.title: The Python base
python.body: Sonarche runs on two Python tools, yt-dlp and beets. That means it needs Python 3.10 or newer on the machine. Nothing gets installed into it: the app builds its own environment alongside.
python.recheckHint: Run the command in a terminal, then come back here.

engine.title: The download engine
engine.body: yt-dlp to fetch the audio, beets to file and tag it. Both are installed into an environment that belongs to Sonarche alone — your system Python is left untouched.
engine.duration: A few minutes, depending on your connection.
engine.bodyBundled: yt-dlp to fetch the audio, beets to file and tag it. Everything ships with the app — its own Python, its own packages — and installs into a corner that belongs to Sonarche alone. Nothing already on your machine is touched.
engine.durationBundled: A few seconds — it is all here already, nothing to download.

acoustid.title: The AcoustID key
acoustid.body: Without a key, Sonarche reads the video title and guesses: your tracks land marked "Guessed tags". With one, it listens to the file, computes its fingerprint and asks AcoustID — the track is identified, artist, album and year included. It's free, and it takes two minutes.

account.label: Create an AcoustID account
account.hint: You can sign in with an account you already have.

application.label: Register an application
application.hint: Name it whatever you like — the key shows up right after.

rejected.invalidKey: AcoustID doesn't recognise this key. Check that you copied the application's key, not the account's.

acoustid.unreachable: Could not reach AcoustID. Check your connection and try again.
acoustid.skip: Continue without — tracks will be tagged by guesswork
acoustid.replace: Paste a new key to replace this one
